droid:strokeColor">
            <gradient android:type="linear" android:startX="27" android:startY="84"
                android:endX="55" android:endY="25"
                android:startColor="{c['left1']}" android:endColor="{c['left2']}" />
        </aapt:attr>
    </path>
    <path android:fillColor="@android:color/transparent" android:strokeColor="{c['right']}"
        android:strokeWidth="11" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:pathData="M55,28C65,45 73,64 80,82" />
    <path android:fillColor="@android:color/transparent" android:strokeColor="{c['accent']}"
        android:strokeWidth="8" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:pathData="M40,64C49,60 59,60 68,64" />
    <path android:fillColor="{c['accent']}" android:pathData="M54,29C60,21 69,19 76,24C73,33 65,37 55,33Z" />
</vector>
'''

for name,c in palettes.items():
    write(f'app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_arbor_background_{name}.xml', background(c))
    write(f'app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_arbor_foreground_{name}.xml', foreground(c))
    write(f'app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_arbor_mark_{name}.xml', mark(c))
    write(f'app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi/ic_launcher_{name}.xml', f'''<adaptive-icon xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <background android:drawable="@drawable/ic_arbor_background_{name}" />
    <foreground android:drawable="@drawable/ic_arbor_foreground_{name}" />
    <monochrome android:drawable="@drawable/ic_arbor_monochrome" />
</adaptive-icon>
''')
    write(f'app/src/main/res/mipmap/ic_launcher_{name}.xml', mark(c))
